research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: VergeSense is researching methods for detecting and visualizing objects within spaces, monitoring occupancy in work areas, and detecting human occupancy and activity using sensor blocks and optical sensors. Their work includes methods for detecting and responding to conditions within a space, commissioning networks of optical sensors across floorspaces, and applying contextual privacy filters to tracked objects. These areas reflect a focus on spatial intelligence and workplace analytics.

overview_description.description: VergeSense is the leading workplace analytics platform trusted by enterprises across the globe. Businesses use VergeSense to transform their static office into a dynamic workplace that matches today's employee needs and expectations. Its AI-driven platform includes intelligent sensors that measure how space is used in real-time. That data is analyzed in a workplace analytics dashboard and integrated into essential hybrid work software applications, like room and desk booking, room availability, employee mobile apps, IWMS and BMS tools and more. Companies use VergeSense to reduce or reinvest real estate, improve building operations, and create spaces where employees can thrive. The impact is reduced costs, higher productivity, improved culture and employee retention, and better sustainability.

about_short_description.short_description: VergeSense is the leading workplace analytics platform and provides spatial intelligence to enterprise companies.

product.name: Meridian
product.description: An AI-powered platform that combines occupancy and decision intelligence to support workplace planning, space-demand forecasting, cost analysis, and portfolio decisions.

product.name: Occupancy Intelligence Platform
product.description: A workplace analytics platform that unifies occupancy data from sensors, WiFi, space-booking systems, badge systems, and other building sources for analysis and operational decisions.

product.name: Infinity Area Sensor
product.description: A privacy-oriented occupancy sensor for measuring granular usage of rooms, collaboration areas, desks, and other workplace spaces, including passive occupancy.

product.name: Workplace Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that interprets occupancy data and provides personalized recommendations for workplace efficiency and real estate decisions.

product.name: Strategic Advisory Services
product.description: Consulting services that help organizations interpret occupancy data and develop real estate, workplace strategy, space planning, and design recommendations.

product.name: Managed Services
product.description: Ongoing operational support for implementing, maintaining, and using VergeSense occupancy intelligence across an organization's workplace portfolio.
